verdict.rationale: Fenwick evidences a broad startup/VC practice, a Startup Resource Center with formation and seed financing content (e.g., 'Incorporation Stage Issues and Seed Financings Overview'), and 1,500+ VC-backed clients, but there is no specific mention of SAFEs, convertible notes, or dedicated explainers/forms for these instruments. Missing for 10: explicit SAFE/convertible note explainers or forms, sample documents, or detailed discussion of pre-seed/seed instrument mechanics.
